name: Iron Soul: Dungeon
desc:
Dragons and men fought side by side. Then the world broke - scattered into floating isles, swarmed by dark creatures born from an ancient seal.

⚔️ Dynamic combat - Face creatures crawling from the depths; each defeat drops rare materials.

🔥 Skill Tree - Unlock and upgrade your own path. Choose abilities that fit your playstyle - become a relentless attacker, a forge master, or a survivor built to last.

⚒️ Crafting loop - Gather, forge, upgrade. Every new weapon changes how you fight.

The world is broken. 
Build your legend - one skill, one strike, one blade at a time.

Cheating/Exploiting will result in PERMANENT BAN.
